description: Red color layers for blood detection. Each layer is an HSV range (OpenCV scale: H 0-180, S 0-255, V 0-255) plus confirmation thresholds. A pixel matches a layer if it falls in the HSV range AND passes the layer's LAB A-channel and R-G redness thresholds. Layers are OR-ed together: a pixel matching any layer is detected as blood. Layers with "grow_only": true are NOT detected directly — they are only accepted if adjacent to already-detected blood (region growing), which catches dark blood edges without covering isolated skin tones.
